Page header: "Total Shipments 4028 Records detected", "Trading Partners 27", "Ports 21", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-24". Buyer-side rows also listed: DE POSH PRIVATE LIMITED (Maldives) 254 shipments, SAPNA CHAUDHARY (UK) 62, NASRALLAH TRADING AGENCY (Jordan) 36, CSP LOGISTICS 38, ARK GROUP LLC (UAE) 385. Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 4028 total shipments; only 5 dated shipment rows were visible in the free view (2 export rows, 3 import rows) — the 4028 figure is the site's counter, not independently verified.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split was retrievable: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and volza.com / eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply activity therefore not evidenced in this pass — null, not inferred.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs rows with destination and HS code: UAE (Jebel Ali) 2026-02-24 HS 96032900, B/L 9957639; UK (London Metropolitan) 2026-02-17 HS 96151900, B/L 9731798. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared_hs 847420 (crushing/grinding machinery for earth, stone, ores — mining/metallurgy) does NOT match any observed record. All visible rows are personal-care/household goods: 96032900 (brushes), 82142010 (nail clippers), 82130000 (scissors), 96151900 (combs). The company is also a large IMPORTER from China (Ningbo, Guangzhou, Wenzhou, Shenzhen) of brushes, scissors and nail clippers, i.e. it is a trader/brand-owner in beauty accessories, not a mining-equipment manufacturer. Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected on HS grounds: verdict accepted_hs_corrected — actual HS codes are 9603/8214/8213/9615, and the claimed 847420 should be corrected. Role: trader (imports finished goods from China, re-exports under own VEGA brand). Registered address on record: 301, Vardhman Vasundhra Plaza, LSC Plot No-1, Vasundhra Enclave (Delhi NCR). Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — not public in the free views; no figures invented. Note that the 4028-shipment counter mixes imports and exports, so it must not be read as export volume.
